text:
maria-sales: Quick sync — Prospect (Edgewave) asked for a POC to run our model in their edge VPC + minimal cloud fallback. They sent an RFI and a 40-row capability matrix. Need to confirm scope, cost anchors, and security answers.

kevin-se: thanks. do we have an existing playbook for hybrid edge + fallback? i can draft an architecture sketch.

maria-sales: not a formal playbook. want a quick matrix: Dedicated vs Private (VPC) vs Private on-prem. Highlight latency tradeoffs and SLA. Also need guidance on data residency and HSM for keys.

tara-security: Edgewave is asking for HSM-backed key management + quarterly pen tests. We can support KMS integrations and HSM in Private, need to confirm SOC2 reports and answer questionnaire Q12 about key custody. I'll pull the standard answers.

sam-eng: for the POC, recommended baseline: 2x A100-class nodes for the model size they want, with our KV-cache enabled and prefix caching. If latency target is <150ms p50 we should use Private dedicated inference with local batch size 1 and sticky routing.

kevin-se: pricing note — POC credit estimate: ~$12k for 2 weeks including infra and eng time. If they want ongoing dedicated, we'd propose a monthly reserved capacity commit. Will put numbers in the capability matrix.

maria-sales: can you add a short "what's included in the POC" section? They asked if we do log retention and whether logs leave their VPC.

tara-security: logs can be kept in-customer VPC for Private deployments; hosted API sends logs to our secure storage (we redact by default). For the questionnaire: Q4 (data egress) answer = "Data remains in customer VPC for Private; hosted API has opt-in retention; we offer encryption at rest and in transit."

kevin-se: attaching draft matrix here: https://drive.redwoodinc/edgewave/poc-matrix-draft (internal) — pls comment.

sam-eng: small config snippet for the POC if helpful:
```
model: redwood-v1.3
deployment: private-vpc
nodes: 2
batch_policy: adaptive
kv_cache: enabled
sticky_sessions: true
```

maria-sales: perfect. can someone fill the security answers and add a row for "fallback behavior" (if edge node fails, fallback to cloud model variant with degraded latency)

tara-security: will add the security Qs and note SOC2 + ISO27001 attachments. Also flag: they asked about HSM certification level — we support AWS CloudHSM + customer-managed HSM in Private. I'll add exact wording.

kevin-se: one blocker from procurement: they want a sentence about removing customer data on contract termination. legal has a standard clause. will ping legal.

sam-eng: deploy-bot: status on private VPC deployment template?

deploy-bot: sam-eng requested template generation for private-vpc at 2026-03-21T14:22:00Z — template created: /infra/templates/private-vpc-edgewave-20260321.yaml :white_check_mark:

maria-sales: ok next steps: kevin — update matrix with POC cost + fallback row; tara — finish RFI answers and attach SOC2; sam — validate perf numbers and add a short runbook for failover. I'll follow up with Edgewave to lock timeline. :thumbsup:

kevin-se: on it, will push updated matrix by EOD PST.

tara-security: drafting answers now, ETA EOD.

sam-eng: I'll run a perf sim tomorrow morning and post numbers.

maria-sales: thanks team — looping legal and AE. will post customer-facing summary when matrix is ready.
